mapper.sql: contract_id, previous_contract_id, creditor_id, debtor_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, status, creditor_address, debtor_address, contract_alias, terms, creditor_signature, debtor_signature, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_contract ( creditor_id, creditor_address, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, contract_alias, terms, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{creditorId}, #{request.creditorAddress}, #{request.principalAmount}, #{request.interestRate}, #{request.repaymentType}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.maturityDate}, #{request.repaymentDay}, #{request.contractAlias}, #{request.terms}, 'DRAFT', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_contract SET creditor_signature = #{signatureData}, debtor_id = #{debtorId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
UPDATE loan_contract SET debtor_address = #{debtorAddress}, debtor_signature = #{signatureData}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT lc.contract_id AS contractId, lc.previous_contract_id AS previousContractId, lc.creditor_id AS creditorId, lc.debtor_id AS debtorId, creditor.name AS creditorName, lc.creditor_address AS creditorAddress, lc.creditor_signature AS creditorSignature, debtor.name AS debtorName, lc.debtor_address AS debtorAddress, lc.debtor_signature AS debtorSignature, lc.principal_amount AS principalAmount, lc.interest_rate AS interestRate, lc.repayment_type AS repaymentType, lc.start_date AS startDate, lc.maturity_date AS maturityDate, lc.repayment_day AS repaymentDay, lc.contract_alias AS contractAlias, lc.terms AS terms, lc.status AS status, lc.created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract lc LEFT JOIN users creditor ON lc.creditor_id = creditor.user_id LEFT JOIN users debtor ON lc.debtor_id = debtor.user_id WHERE lc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT lc.contract_id AS contractId, lc.previous_contract_id AS previousContractId, lc.creditor_id AS creditorId, lc.debtor_id AS debtorId, lc.creditor_address AS creditorAddress, lc.creditor_signature AS creditorSignature, lc.debtor_address AS debtorAddress, lc.debtor_signature AS debtorSignature, lc.principal_amount AS principalAmount, lc.interest_rate AS interestRate, lc.repayment_type AS repaymentType, lc.start_date AS startDate, lc.maturity_date AS maturityDate, lc.repayment_day AS repaymentDay, lc.contract_alias AS contractAlias, lc.terms AS terms, lc.status AS status, lc.created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract lc WHERE lc.creditor_id = #{userId} OR lc.debtor_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lc.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_contract SET debtor_id = #{debtorId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_contract ( previous_contract_id, creditor_id, debtor_id, principal_amount, interest_rate, repayment_type, start_date, maturity_date, repayment_day, creditor_address, debtor_address, contract_alias, terms, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{previousContractId}, #{creditorId}, #{debtorId}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestRate}, #{repaymentType}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{repaymentDay}, #{creditorAddress}, #{debtorAddress}, #{contractAlias}, #{terms}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
